text:
Anya: quick sanity check — proposing we harden the runtime <-> control-plane interface before the next modularization sprint. goal: non-breaking surface for rollouts + tenant bulkhead isolation. thoughts?

Ben: +1. my plan: three phases — (1) contract freeze + explicit schema versioning, (2) lightweight bulkhead proxy per-tenant (queue + circuit-breaker), (3) canary + compatibility test harness. keep all changes behind feature flags so we can revert fast.

Carla: real concern is telemetry and trace continuity. inserting proxies often strips span context. we need an explicit header propagation contract and a mapping plan for existing traces. also add a migration path for log formats.

Deepak: perf note: adding a proxy hop will likely add ~5-20ms p50 depending on hot path. can we provide a fast-path passthrough for hot tenants or bypass for certain workloads? recommend a 2-week perf spike with realistic QPS to quantify.

Anya: good call. ownership: infra + runtime + product infra. I'm thinking an incremental approach: freeze contracts -> telemetry compatibility checks -> stub bulkhead -> full bulkhead with enforcement. I'll draft an RFC with phases and a migration checklist (tracing, metrics, rollback, test-grid).

Ben: I'll sketch the proxy interface today. keep it intentionally small. early sketch for policy shape: 
```json
{
  "tenant_id": "string",
  "quota": {"tokens_per_min": 100000},
  "circuit": {"failure_threshold": 0.05, "window_s": 60},
  "trace": {"propagate_headers": ["x-request-id","x-trace-id"]}
}
```

Carla: add a telemetry compatibility test to the eval harness so we can detect missing spans or malformed logs during canary. otherwise we won't notice until post-cut.

Deepak: +1. also add a perf gate in CI for the 2-week spike branch. want p50/p95 numbers before we approve phase 2.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy started for infra/stub-bulkhead @ 1764443275

Anya: thanks — I'll post the RFC draft in #architecture tomorrow and tag @Ben @Carla @Deepak. aiming to kick the spike the week after release X if no blockers. :thumbsup:
